# Brikka design system

> The token graph, the themes and the decisions a host needs to paint with
> Brikka without registering a single element. Every name here is public API.

## Design system

- [Foundations](design-system/foundations.md): Colour decides meaning, type decides hierarchy, space decides rhythm, elevation decides what floats, an edge decides how hard a boundary reads, motion decides how a change arrives, and layout decides where the page breaks.
- [Principles](design-system/principles.md): The core is the set of decisions, not their values; a brand supplies values, never names. Four levels say how far you go, and the guards say what cannot break.
- [Tokens](design-system/tokens.md): The families Brikka declares, the roles a page paints with, the four axes, and the families it deliberately refuses.
